review_pass_1.findings: Checked N oxidation states and separate uptake/reduction/assimilation/fixation, mineralization and microbial pathways, negative cytosolic voltage sign, proton symport free energy, NPF and NRT2 context, AMT regulation, ammonium speciation, nitrate pools and redistribution, carbon/energy requirements, isotope inference and nitrogen budgets. Recomputed signed membrane energy, pH fractions, rate, electron and mass balances and checked question answers. Revised schematics and references.

review_pass_2.type: Separate internal editorial and static reader review
review_pass_2.findings: Compared with 6.A.04 exemplar; 13,442 words in 142 unique teaching paragraphs; progressive sections, glossary, 12 labeled SVGs and zoom targets, 50 explained questions, 17 traps and 14 recall prompts; answer positions balanced; canonical, anchors and IDs checked. Existing reader controls and adjacent navigation retained. Browser runtime not tested.

quality.basis: Internal rubric, not independent certification; deductions for limited independent review, schematic SVGs not visually rendered, some concise distractor explanations, no interactive accessibility test and no browser runtime test.
